visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with an extreme close-up of a purple and blue swirl-colored shaved ice dish topped with a thick layer of white cream and lime zest; a spoon scoops a portion of the airy, textured ice. (2) The camera cuts to the interior of a shaved ice machine where a thin, blue-colored sheet of ice is being shaved into a delicate, ruffled pile in a blue bowl. (3) A female server wearing a dark uniform, glasses, and a gray apron walks through a bright, clean indoor restaurant towards the camera, smiling and holding a tray with a bowl of yellow shaved ice and two blue mugs. (4) Close-up shot showing two blue mugs being clinked together over a wooden table, with two bowls of shaved ice (one yellow, one blue) in the background. (5) Another shot of the ice machine, this time shaving light blue ice into ruffles. (6) A series of close-ups shows the preparation of the butterfly pea flower shaved ice: white cream is piped onto the blue ice mountain, followed by fresh lime zest being grated over it, and then a clear yellow liquid (lemon juice) being poured from a small pitcher over the cream. (7) A clear, jelly-like topping (Aiyu jelly) is poured from a small bowl onto the side of the blue shaved ice. (8) Transition to the yellow shaved ice: the ice machine shaves yellow ice, which is then surrounded by cubes of fresh yellow mango on a tray; yellow mango sauce is drizzled over a cream topping, and a spoon digs into the side. (9) Transition to a dark gray shaved ice: the machine shaves gray ice, black sesame sauce is drizzled in a spiral, and chopped nuts are sprinkled on top. (10) A spoon scoops the sesame ice, revealing its fluffy texture, and small purple and yellow taro/sweet potato balls are poured into the bowl. (11) Transition to light brown shaved ice: the ice is topped with cream, chopped nuts, and toasted rice puffs; a small dish of black pearls (boba) is shown in close-up. (12) The female server is seen in a medium shot behind a counter, preparing a dish in a brightly lit indoor space with large windows. (13) The final shots show the storefront of the shop, a two-story building with a yellow and blue sign featuring Chinese characters under a clear sky.
